timeline.text: Testing a task set meant running it for real — burning a kid's one real attempt.
There was no way to check a fix without risking a child's actual progress.
Parents also found the read-aloud voice too fast, with no way to test a new speed first.
Now a sandbox replays any child's tasks in Supabase without writing a single real row.
And a slider lets a parent test the voice — half speed up to one-point-three times — before it saves.
